interface.name: archtv_launcher_bridge_v1
interface.description: Only the kernel-authenticated Android display connection may bind. Complete succeeds only after all catalog entries; a launch return is never evidence of a frame. Requests are never automatically retried.

arg.name: status
arg.summary: 0 returned, 1 rejected, 2 backend failure, 3 unavailable, 4 indeterminate
